newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'shita Elec sees strong Q1, concerned on 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: M'shita Elec sees strong Q1, concerned on 2nd half.

text.p: Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd expects its earnings in the April-June quarter to be fairly strong, helped by exports, but the company is concerned about results for the second half of 1997/98, due to economic uncertainty, Motoi Matsuda, a managing director, told reporters on Thursday.
"Our results in the first quarter will be fairly strong, but we will probably not change the full-year (1997/98) forecast," Matsuda said.

In the first quarter, Matsuda said, higher exports, a stable yen and strong demand for its products overall boosted Matsushita Electric's earnings easily by more than 10 percent from the year-ago period.
The company is expected to announce its first quarter results in late August.
"Our first half results will be very good," Matsuda said, although he added that earnings in the July-September quarter will be lower than those of the April-June quarter.
"We will be concerned if this declining trend continues in the second half," he added. "We are not sure that the (Japanese) economy is fully on a recovery track."

He cited a cut in government spending, uncertainties regarding the yen exchange rate and continuing declines in product prices as probable negative factors for the company's earnings in the second half of 1997/98.
